overview_description.description: Talmaro is a Dubai-based HR technology company that provides cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) software designed primarily for small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). Founded in 2016 by Ayman Badawi, the company focuses on simplifying and automating HR operations for businesses across the Middle East, especially the GCC region.
